items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: So he sent for me, and I went there, and I worked in his grocery store

ctx.x: Yeah, I was still in high school. But I was actually out making money. So they disqualified me. But my trophies and everything are still there.

In fact, I left school in the Eleventh Grade. My Uncle, (?) Bernard(?) Reed and his wife, who was like my second mother, Lydia, they moved to Detroit. And as soon as he got himself going pretty well, anybody from home who wanted to come to Detroit, who figured they had a better chance...and he was sending for them. So he sent for me, and I went there, and I worked in his grocery store, and I started finding my way around.
